sections.content:
So, heres a very quick scenario. 

Connecting two claude codes on different machines 
A small app to run on either side and manage a queue 

I want to help a remote agent debug something. We want to establishe a collaborative link

lets build it in relay. 
It should be as small as possible. 
Ideally I just share a single link to someone via chat, and their claude can pull it in
